faqs.a1: Nuave is an AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) platform that measures how often AI tools like ChatGPT mention your brand when users ask about your business category. You get a visibility score of 0–100 along with content recommendations to improve it.
faqs.a2: AEO or Answer Engine Optimization is a strategy to get your brand mentioned by AI like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini when answering user questions. Unlike SEO which focuses on Google rankings, AEO focuses on "does AI know and recommend your business?"
faqs.q3: How is AEO different from SEO?
faqs.a3: SEO helps your website appear on Google. AEO makes your brand mentioned by AI. Both are important, but more and more people are asking ChatGPT directly without opening Google at all.
faqs.q4: Why do I need to know if AI mentions my brand?
faqs.a4: Because millions of people now ask AI: "What's the best accounting software for a small restaurant?" If your brand isn't mentioned, you don't exist in that potential customer's mind. And they're ready to buy.
faqs.a5: You enter your brand name and website URL. Nuave automatically analyzes your website, creates 10 relevant questions for your business, then sends them to GPT-4o to see if your brand is mentioned. Results come in minutes.
faqs.a6: Nuave uses a credit system, not a monthly subscription. Sign up for free and get 10 credits instantly — enough for one full audit. Additional plans start from Rp 75,000.
faqs.q7: Which AI tools does Nuave analyze?
faqs.a7: Currently, Nuave simulates results from GPT-4o (ChatGPT). Support for Perplexity, Gemini, Meta AI, and other models is coming soon.
faqs.a8: Not at all. Just enter your brand name and website URL, and Nuave handles the rest.
faqs.q9: Do I need a website to use Nuave?
faqs.a9: Yes. Nuave needs a website URL to automatically analyze your business content.
faqs.q10: I don't have a website yet — is Nuave still useful?
faqs.a10: It can be, but results will almost certainly be low. Without a website, AI has no clear information source, making your brand hard to recognize or trust.

harga.faq1q: What's the difference between monthly audit and daily monitoring?
harga.faq1a: Monthly audit runs all your prompts comprehensively and generates problem analysis + recommendations. Daily monitoring tracks visibility scores without deep analysis — like checking your temperature every day.
harga.faq2q: Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
harga.faq2a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing. Downgrades apply at the end of the current billing period.
harga.faq3q: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
harga.faq3a: Your data stays safe. Brands and prompts exceeding the new plan limits will be frozen (not deleted) — you can access them again after upgrading.
harga.faq4a: Bank transfer (BCA, BNI, BRI, Mandiri), GoPay, OVO, QRIS, Indomaret, Alfamart, and credit/debit cards — all through Midtrans.
harga.faq5a: Monthly plans: access continues until end of period, no refund. Annual plans: prorated refund for unused months. Cancellation within the first 48 hours gets a full refund.
harga.faq6q: Is the 20% annual discount really worth it?
harga.faq6a: Yes — if you plan to use Nuave for more than 3 months. AEO is a long-term game, results show in 2-3 months. Annual plans ensure consistent monitoring.

privacy.intro1: Nuave ("we") is committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (PDP Law) of the Republic of Indonesia. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when using the Nuave service at https://nuave.ai.
privacy.intro2: By using our service, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section1Intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacy.section1_1Row1: Full name|Provided via Google OAuth during registration
privacy.section1_1Row2: Email address|Provided via Google OAuth during registration
privacy.section1_1Row3: User ID|Automatically generated by our system (Supabase Auth)
privacy.section1_2Row1: Brand name|Entered by the user for AEO audit purposes
privacy.section1_2Row2: Website URL|Entered by the user; used for public content scraping
privacy.section1_2Row3: Business profile information|Company overview, product differentiation, competitors — AI-generated from public website content
privacy.section1_3Row1: Audit results|AI responses from GPT-4o, visibility scores, competitor analysis
privacy.section1_3Row2: Credit transaction history|Credit purchases, credit usage, balance
privacy.section1_3Row3: Activity logs|Audit timestamps, types of actions performed
privacy.section1_4Row1: Session data|Authentication tokens (stored in httpOnly cookies)
privacy.section1_4Row2: IP address|For rate limiting and system security purposes
privacy.section1Note: Note: We do not collect sensitive data such as national ID numbers, health data, biometric data, sexual orientation, political views, or financial data (credit cards are processed directly by Stripe and never touch our servers).
privacy.section2Intro: In accordance with Article 20 of the PDP Law, we process your personal data based on:
privacy.section2Item1Desc: You provide explicit consent when registering and using our service.
privacy.section2Item2Desc: Processing is necessary to provide the AEO audit service you requested.
privacy.section2Item3Desc: For system security, fraud prevention, and service quality improvement.
privacy.section3Item1: Provide and operate the AEO audit service (sending prompts to GPT-4o, analyzing AI responses, calculating Visibility Score)
privacy.section3Item2: Authenticate your identity and manage your account
privacy.section3Item3: Manage credit balances and process payment transactions
privacy.section3Item4: Generate content recommendations and blog articles using Claude AI
privacy.section3Item5: Improve the accuracy and quality of our service
privacy.section3Item6: Fulfill legal obligations and prevent service abuse
privacy.section3Item7: Send service-related notifications (not marketing without consent)
privacy.section4Intro: In accordance with Article 56 of the PDP Law, we inform you that your data is processed by the following third-party service providers:
privacy.section4Row1: Supabase|Database & authentication|Singapore (AWS ap-southeast-1)|Email, name, audit data, credit history
privacy.section4Row2: OpenAI (GPT-4o)|AI prompt simulation|United States|Generated prompt text (no PII)
privacy.section4Row3: Anthropic (Claude)|Website scraping, analysis, recommendations|United States|Public website URLs, public content text
privacy.section4Row4: Stripe|Payment processing|United States|Email, transaction history (card data never touches our servers)
privacy.section4Row5: Vercel|Web application hosting|United States / Global Edge|HTTP requests, access logs
privacy.section5Row1: User account data|While account is active + 30 days after account deletion
privacy.section5Row2: Audit results (with account)|While account is active
privacy.section5Row3: Anonymous audits (no account)|48 hours — automatically deleted
privacy.section5Row4: Credit transaction history|5 years (Indonesian tax law obligation)
privacy.section6Title: Your Rights as a Data Subject
privacy.section6Intro: In accordance with Articles 5-16 of the PDP Law, you have the following rights:
privacy.section6Right1Desc: Request a copy of your personal data that we store.
privacy.section6Right2Desc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.section6Right3Desc: Request deletion of your personal data ('right to be forgotten').
privacy.section6Right4Desc: Request restriction of processing your data under certain conditions.
privacy.section6Right5Desc: Receive your data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.section6Right6Desc: Object to data processing for specific purposes including marketing.
privacy.section6Right7Desc: Withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
privacy.section6Right8Desc: Lodge a complaint with us or with the Personal Data Protection Authority.
privacy.section6Footer: To exercise any of the above rights, send a request to hello@nuave.ai. We will respond within 14 business days.
privacy.section7Intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures, including:
privacy.section7Item1: Data encryption in transit using TLS/HTTPS
privacy.section7Item2: Authentication tokens stored in httpOnly cookies (not accessible by JavaScript)
privacy.section7Item3: Row Level Security (RLS) in Supabase — each user can only access their own data
privacy.section7Item4: AI API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic) stored server-side only, never exposed to the browser
privacy.section7Item5: Rate limiting on critical endpoints to prevent abuse
privacy.section7Item6: Stripe keys verified via webhook signature for every transaction
privacy.section8Intro: We use cookies necessary for authentication functionality:
privacy.section8Row1: Supabase session cookie|httpOnly, Secure — maintains your login status — until logout
privacy.section8Row2: Browser sessionStorage|Client-side only — temporarily stores brand & URL before login — deleted when tab closes
privacy.section8Footer: We do not use third-party analytics cookies or cross-site trackers on authenticated pages.
privacy.section9Body: Nuave's Service is intended for users aged 18 years and older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you become aware that someone under 18 has registered, please contact us at hello@nuave.ai.
privacy.section10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified via email or in-app notification at least 14 days before taking effect.
privacy.section11Intro: For questions, data subject rights requests, or privacy-related complaints:
